economic_hypothesis: After a material decline, a first low reveals demand, an intervening rebound establishes a causal neckline, and a later second low that holds slightly above the first indicates seller exhaustion. A high-close, normal-or-better-turnover first close through the neckline marks completed transfer from weak holders to stronger buyers.

stage_a_governance.outcome_blind_semantic_revision: Require temporal separation around the neckline peak, a non-undercutting second low, and a signal close no more than 5% above the neckline. This revision was frozen before any return was read.

frozen_signal.pre_structure_high_window: 60 through 36 completed same-symbol sessions before signal
frozen_signal.first_low_window: 35 through 12 completed same-symbol sessions before signal
frozen_signal.second_low_window: 10 through 2 completed same-symbol sessions before signal
frozen_signal.neckline: maximum coordinate high strictly between first-low and second-low sessions
frozen_signal.breakout: prior completed close below neckline and signal completed close at or above neckline

execution.entry: first legal executable daily open after completed signal, no later than three market sessions

order: highest median annual mean net return
